Is it time yet??! 🎄🍪🧁✨ these rolls are filled with cookie dough truffles, sugar cookie mix, and crushed sugar cookies — sugar cookie overload!!  🎄recipe🎄  cookie dough truffles: ﻿﻿½ cup unsalted butter (room temperature) ﻿﻿¾ cup granulated sugar ﻿﻿1 tsp vanilla extract  ﻿﻿2 cups all-purpose flour 14 ounces sweetened condensed milk ½ tsp. salt cinnamon roll dough: ﻿﻿1/2 cup water (warm) ﻿﻿1 tbsp active dry yeast ﻿﻿1/2 cup whole fat buttermilk (room temperature) ﻿﻿1/2 cup + 1/2 tsp granulated sugar (divided) ﻿﻿1 tsp. salt ﻿﻿1 tsp. vanilla extract ﻿﻿2 large eggs ﻿﻿6 tbsp unsalted butter (melted and slightly cooled) ﻿﻿3 1/2-4 cups all purpose flour Filling: ﻿﻿6 tbsp unsalted butter (super soft) ﻿﻿1 cup granulated sugar ﻿﻿2 tbsp cinnamon ﻿﻿1/2 cup dry Sugar Cookie Mix Buttercream frosting: 1 cup unsalted butter (room temperature) 1 tsp vanilla extract  7-8 cups powdered sugar About ½ cup of milk (add less or more depending on consistency)  Optional: holiday sprinkles on top!  🎄instructions🎄 Cookie Dough Truffles: -Using a stand mixer (or a large bowl and hand mixer ), cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. -Add vanilla extract.  -With speed on low, add flour, alternating with condensed milk, and add the salt. Beat until well combined.  -Roll into 1-inch balls and place in fridge until ready to use. You will have extra cookie dough, can use them in other recipes or so eat on its own!  Cinnamon roll dough:  -Using a stand mixer, with the paddle attachment, add warm water, yeast, and granulated sugar. -Allow yeast to bloom for 5-10 minutes, the batter will puff up. -Add in buttermilk, granulated sugar, melted butter, eggs, vanilla extract, and salt. Mix until fully combined. -Switch to a hook attachment and add in 2 1/2 cups of the flour.  -Then add another 1 cup of flour. Knead mixture until combined.  -Continue to knead on low speed about 5 - 6 minutes while adding a little more flour as needed to reach a soft and moist dough, 10-12 minutes by hand. -Transfer dough to an oiled bowl, cover with a clean kitchen towel or plastic wrap. Let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, 1- 1 1/2 hours. -Once the dough has doubled in size then punch dough down. -Dust a working surface lightly with flour. -Roll dough out into an 20 by 18-inch rectangle. -Spread the softened butter evenly over entire surface (hands work best). For the Filling: -In a medium sized bowl, add the granulated sugar, cinnamon, and sugar cookie mix. Mix until well combined.  -Sprinkle and spread cinnamon sugar cookie mixture evenly over butter layer.  -Chop and crush the sugar cookies and sprinkle over evenly on top of the cinnamon sugar cookie mixture.  -And then add about 30 cookie dough truffles over the top. You can use less or more if desired. -Beginning on an 18-inch side tightly roll dough into a cylinder. Cut into 12 equal portions. Or cut individual strips. And roll one by one, tightly.  -Grease a 9-x-13-inch pan with softened butter, and place the cinnamon rolls.   -Cover with clean kitchen towel or plastic wrap loosely. -Let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1- 1 1/2 hours. -Preheat oven to 350° near the last 20 minutes of rolls rising. -Bake rolls for 25-30 minutes. -When rolls are done baking, add  the butter and two cups of powdered sugar in a large bowl. Cream until well combined.  -Add vanilla extract.  -Continue to add powdered sugar 1 cup at a time.  -When it starts to get too thick begin to add the milk. -Keep adding powdered sugar until you reach desired consistency. -Frost the rolls and add holiday sprinkles. Zimtschnecken - die Weltbesten! 😍 Sooo unfassbar fluffig  🤤🤤 Zutaten für den Teig: • 600g Mehl ( Typ 550 ) • 300ml Milch ( lauwarm ) • 7g trocken Hefe ( o. 1 Halben Würfel • frische Hefe ) • 110g Butter flüssig • 80g Puderzucker  • 25g Zucker • Vanille • 1TL Salz Zutaten für die Füllung: • 110g Butter ( weich ) • 200g Rohrzucker • 70g Blütenhonig  • 2,5 TL Zimt • 2 El Sahne ( nur wenn die Masse noch zu • fest ist ) Frosting: • 175g Philadelphia • 80g Butter ( weich ) • 80g Puderzucker  • 40-50ml Sahne in die Backform  Step 1: Als erstes wird die Milch erwärmt, sie darf jedoch nicht heiß sein! In die Milch kommt die Hefe, kurz umrühren und mind. 5-10min stehen lassen. ( so wird die Hefe aktiviert ) In eine Schüssel geben wir dass Mehl, in welches wir eine Mulde bilden, zuerst die flüssigen Zutaten und dann dir trockenen Zutaten hinzugeben. Dass ganze jetzt zu einem Teig kneten. Zum kneten Mehl verwenden. Der Teig sollte weich sein, dennoch aber kaum kleben! Sobald zuviel mehl im Teig ist, werden die Zimmtrollen nicht fluffig und weich, deshalb unbedingt aufpassen und nicht unmengen an Mehl nachgeben!!! Den Teig lassen wir luftdicht verschlossen, an einem warmen Ort mind.  1-1,5 Std gehen. Um es zu beschleunigen, könnt ihr den Ofen auf 50 grad Umluft anschalten. Die Schüssel kommt für 20 min mit angeschaltenem und weitere 20 mit  ausgeschaltenem zum gehen in den Ofen ( dass Tuch im Video dient es nur als Deko, die Schüssel MUSS luftdicht verschlossen sein! )  Step 2: In der Zwischenzeit bereiten wir die Füllung vor. Hierzu nimmst du die Butter und schlägst sie auf, bis sich die Farbe von dunkel gelb zu einem hellen gelb ändert. Anschließend gibst du die restlichen Zutaten hinzu und mixt es nochmal kurz bis eine homogene Masse entsteht. ( Man sollte sie leicht verstreichen können ) Step 3: Sobald der Teig aufgegangen ist ( sich mind. Verdoppelt hat) drückst du die Luft raus und rollst ihn mit Hilfe von etwas Mehl zu einem Viereck aus, ca 0,5 cm dick. Jetzt solltest du auch den Ofen einschalten, 170 grad Ober/Unterhitze falls du es vergessen hast. Step 4: Wenn du deinen Teig gleichmäßig dick ausgerollt hast, kommt nun auf den Teig deine Füllung, verstreiche sie gleichmäßig. Step 5: Jetzt rollst du den Teig vorsichtig ein. Anschließend nimmst du ein Nähgarn. Mit diesem drückst du deine Stücke ein, bevor du sie schneidest um gleich große Stücke zu erhalten. Wenn dass getan ist drückst du den Garn an der Arbeitsplatte unter die Rolle um sie nicht durch hochheben zu zerquetschen.  Nimm den Garn überkreuz und zieh dran dass es dir die Stücke runterschneidet. Step 6: Die Schnecken setzt du jetzt in deine Backform. (am besten eine Glas oder Keramikform) Du lässt diese abgedeckt jetzt weitere 15-20 min ruhen. Bevor es in den Ofen geht gibst du etwas Sahne auf den Boden der Backform.  30-35 Minuten werden sie gebacken. Step 7: Während die Zimtschnecken backen bereiten wir dass Frosting vor. Hierzu nimmst du gesiebten Puderzucker und verrührst ihn mit der weichen Bitter und dem Philadelphia.  Step 8: Nachdem die Zimtschnecken aus dem Ofen kommen lassen wir sie ein wenig abkühlen.  Dass Frosting sollte dann drauf getan werden, wenn Sie nicht mehr heiß aber dennoch warm sind. Chilli oil noodles 🍜  Ingredients - 280g flour - 160g warm water - A pinch salt - 3 tbsp veg oil - 2 cloves garlic, minced - 2 spring onions finely sliced - 1 tsp chilli flakes - 0.5 tsp cumin seeds - 0.5 tsp Szechuan peppercorns Method 1. Start by making the dough. In a mixing bowl place the flour and salt. Make a well in the centre and pour in the water. 2. Mix until it comes together and you have a shaggy dough. Then turn it out and knead for 6-7 minutes or until you have a smooth dough. 3. Cut into 4 pieces and roll into rounds. 4. Pour 0.5 tsp of oil into a bowl and place the dough ball into it, cover and let rest for 1 hour. 5. When ready, place a large pot of salted water on to boil, and the remainder of the oil in a small pot to heat. 6. Working with one dough ball at a time, flatten it out then make a divot in the centre with a chopstick. Then grab each end and pull to stretch it. Once you have pulled it to around 1 metre, tear the strip in half. 7. Place the pulled noodles into the boiling water and cook for 3-4 minutes. 8. Place the garlic, spring onions, chilli, cumin and Szechuan peppercorns into your bowl. 9. Carefully pour the hot oil over the spices and veg in the bowl before adding in the cooked and drained noodles. NO BAKE RASPBERRY CHEESECAKE WITH WHITE CHOCOLATE #raspberry #chocolate #cheesecake #food #Recipe #tiktokfood #fy #fyp #foryou #foryoupage   COOKIE DOUGH 180 gr Maria biscuits 160 gr unsalted butter   RASPBERRY MIXTURE 200 gr raspberries (frozen) 75 gr granulated sugar   CHEESECAKE MIXTURE 150 gr white chocolate   250 gr mascarpone cheese 16 gr whipping cream stabilizer (2 packets) 35 gr powdered sugar 8 gr vanilla sugar (1 packet) 200 gr cream cheese 400 ml heavy cream   TOPPING 45 ml unwhipped cream 100 gr white chocolate   GARNISH cream raspberries mint leaves   Melt 150 grams of white chocolate using a double boiler and let it come to room temperature.   Melt the butter over low heat in a saucepan.   Grind the Maria biscuits finely using a food processor. Add the melted butter and mix until smooth.   Take a springform pan or baking pan and line it with parchment paper. Spread the cookie dough evenly over the bottom and press firmly using the bottom of a spoon, extending to the sides. Place the baking pan with the cookie dough briefly in the refrigerator.   Place the raspberries and sugar in a skillet over medium-high heat and bring to a boil for 7-10 minutes. Stir regularly.   Take a bowl and place a sieve over it. Pour the raspberry mixture through the sieve and press it well with a spatula or spoon to leave the seeds behind. Then pour the raspberry syrup into a piping bag.   Put the mascarpone cheese, whipping stabilizer, powdered sugar, and vanilla sugar in a deep bowl. Mix for 1 minute until combined. Gradually add the cooled melted white chocolate and mix well. Then add the cream cheese and mix again. Slowly add the whipped cream and mix until the mixture stiffens. Note: Make sure the mascarpone cheese, cream cheese, and melted white chocolate are at room temperature, but the whipped cream is cold.   Divide the cheesecake mixture evenly between 2 bowls.   Add some of the raspberry syrup to one of the bowls with cheesecake mixture. I used 35 grams, but you can add more according to your taste.   Spread the white cheesecake mixture evenly over the baking pan. Reserve a bit of the white cheesecake mixture for garnish and put it in a piping bag with a nozzle (store in the refrigerator).   Pipe some raspberry syrup over the white cheesecake mixture and spread the raspberry mixture evenly over it.   Bring the heavy cream almost to a boil. Add the pieces of white chocolate and let it sit for 1 minute. Then mix until smooth.   Spread the white chocolate ganache evenly over the cheesecake. Pipe some raspberry syrup on top and use a toothpick to create a marble pattern.   Cover the raspberry cheesecake and refrigerate to set, preferably overnight.   Cut the raspberry cheesecake into slices. If desired, garnish with a dollop of cream, fresh raspberries, and mint leaves. Bismillah, enjoy!

Edit: GUYS. I HAVE BEEN EDUCATED. PLEASE. I know the life of a tripod fish has some misinformation in it now, but I did not know that when I made this video. I know I was misinformed, and the 101st person correcting me doesn’t do anything more than the first person that did. What do you want me to do? Delete the video? Ts has millions of views, no. I still feel bad for Tripod fish but not because of that video, but because I feel bad for most animals, because almost everything is prey to something. Pretend this video is about how theyre defenceless to much bigger prey, or pretend its a fictional fandom about that video. I PROMISE you, there are deeper and much much worse things that could AND SHOULD be occupying that headspace right now that people that are misinformed about a fish at the bottom of the sea. #tripodfish #fish #edit #fyp #xyzabc Some tripod fish facts! - Since tripod fish is a simultaneous hermaphrodie, it can technically make baby tripod fish with itself - Its full government name is ‘Bathypterois grallator’ and ‘bathypterois’ means ‘deep feathery’ Thought it only fitting that I should have a go at some tripod fish facts before we get into our dinosaur of the day, which is… 🥁🥁🥁🥁 Parasaurolophus!! William Parks was the first man to write about Parasaurolophus, and he thought that they looked like Saurolophus, and so named them ‘Parasaurolophus’, meaning ‘like saurolophus’ 😭😭 Saurolophus was another duck-billed dinosaur and that name means ‘lizard crest’.  Para was around 33-40ft (10-12m) long and 8ft (2.8m) tall at the hips.  Para had a large, hollow crest - inside the crest was an empty tube that started around its nostrils and looped around inside the crest before directing back at the scull. Its been debated what this was used for. It could have been a way to identify others of its species, used to create a resonating sound to communicate, or used to regulate its temperature.  Of course, it is also possible that it was used for all three!! There’s not always one answer!! These were advanced and sophisticated animals that evolved and adapted to their environment in miraculous ways!! Parasaurolophus sculls have been found of all different shapes and sizes and paleontologists have debated the reason for this. Is it a sign of age? Sex? We’re not sure and havent been able to get a hold of any Parasaurolophus to ask them. However!! In the 1990’s, scientists blew air through the crest and it created a trumpeting sound (just search parasaurolophus sound here on tiktok if you somehow havent heard it)  We have found preserved Parasaurolophus skin impressions and have concluded that it had scaley skin. Para was herbivorous, using its many teeth to grind plants up like many hadrosaurs such as Edmontosaurus, Maiasaura, Lambeosaurus etc. Para had four legs, and could have very easily made both quadrupedal and bipedal movements.  Para didnt have any special defence mechanism that it adapted over time in the way we see with other herbivores such as Ankylosaurus, Therizinosaurus, Stegosaurus etc. Though, they were rather large, which would have potentially made them a harder target for predators, and we have presumed that they moved in herds, relying on saftey in numbers.  Parasaurolophus lived in the Late Cretaceous period, and they’ve been found in Alberta in Canada, and both Utah and New Mexico in the US. Alright, thats it I think! When the doctors told me I was going to lose my tongue I immediately thought I would never eat again. Doctor after doctor reassured me that it didn’t mean that.  And while they didn’t lie, food is not at the center of my life like it was before getting sick. My already complicated relationship with it has become even more confusing.  I smell food and I crave it. I watch mukbangs and drool over other people’s ability to crunch and bite and chew. I cook for my husband on an almost daily basis and love being in the kitchen. But when it comes to feeding myself it feels like more often than not I fail at it.  Only recently have I found a sweet spot. Soft foods, small bites, lots of milk to pull the food from the front to the back of my mouth, lots of sauce and lots of patience. I choke. I get frustrated. I go days with out trying because it’s just so difficult.  But I will not give up.  When I got to work today, the ensure I had left in the cafeteria fridge had been thrown away. My fault, I knew better. We can’t keep personal food in the fridges because of the health inspector. But I realized I had no “food”. I was going to have run a whole shift on an empty stomach.  I decided I had no choice. I went down to the restaurant in the hotel and asked chef for 2 soft poached eggs and hollandaise, a safe food I had eaten at home in privacy. I have avoided this process in public for a multitude of reasons but was left with no choice.  And guess what, it worked! I did it. I ate 2 whole eggs. I had FOOD for breakfast. 😭 OH and YES I can taste it. And YES it’s delicious.  A big win in my world. 🌎 remember you too, can do hard things. 💕 Love yall.  #cancersucks #cancersurvivor #glossectomy #tonguecancer #creatorsearchinsights #OvercomeYourFear #eggs

I tried recording sounds by placing my microphones on these megaliths but I couldn’t capture anything clear. Later, in Quiberon, I spotted a few isolated menhirs scattered across the landscape. It was a very windy day, so I attempted another recording. I placed a geophone at the base of one of the menhirs and a contact microphone a little higher on the stone. This time, it worked: I was able to capture something interesting, which you can hear in the video. Without those weather conditions, I probably wouldn’t have recorded anything. 100 formas de hacer papas - #6 Bombas de Papa Seguimos con la serie de 100 recetas diferentes con papas. SÍ, 100 recetas Hoy un clásico argentino, y estoy seguro que de muchos paises también. Bombas de papa o croquetas de papa. Como cualquier receta clásica, hay muchas formas distintas de hacerlas. Estas son con un puré de papa simple y corazón de muzzarella. Se pueden rellenar con carne u otras cosas, así como agregarle hierbas al puré o al rebozado. PROCEDIMIENTO: 1) Hervir a fuego moderado 1 kg de papas, enteras, con un puñado de sal hasta que estén tiernas. Colar y pisar y condimentar con 25 gr de manteca, pimienta negra, nuez moscada, y más sal si fuera necesario. Reservar hasta que el puré esté a temperatura ambiente y llevar a heladera hasta enfriar bien. (También se puede usar puré sobrante de un día anterior, en ese caso, si el puré llevaba leche, agregarle un poco de harina a ojo para que no quede tan líquido) 2) Con el puré frío y las manos un poco humedecidas formar las croquetas colocando un puñado de puré sobre la palma de la mano. Aplanarlo y colocarle muzzarella (yo usé dos muzzarellas distintas, una pre rallada bien sequita y otra más húmeda) o el relleno deseado. Llevar los bordes hacia adentro dejando solo una cara del relleno por cubrir. Colocar más puré sobre ese lado y darle forma de bola a la croqueta. Asegurarse de que no quede aire dentro del relleno para que luego no se exploten al cocinarse. 3) Pasar por harina, huevo batido y pan rallado. Colocar en un plato y llevar al frío 20 minutos. Warning: these Grinch cookie butter cinnamon rolls may cause your heart to grow 3 sizes 💚💚💚 🎄recipe🎄 Dough: ﻿﻿1 cup warm whole milk  ﻿﻿3 tsp active dry yeast ﻿﻿⅓ cup light brown sugar ﻿﻿⅓ cup unsalted butter (melted) ﻿﻿1 tsp vanilla extract ﻿﻿2 large eggs ﻿﻿4 cups  all-purpose ﻿﻿1 tsp salt 1-2 tbsp green food coloring Filling: ﻿﻿¼ cup unsalted butter (melted) ﻿﻿¼ cup cookie butter ﻿﻿½ cup light brown sugar ﻿﻿1 tbsp ground cinnamon Frosting: ﻿﻿8 oz cream cheese (room temperature) ﻿﻿¼ cup unsalted butter (room temperature) ﻿﻿¼ cup cookie butter ﻿﻿2 cups powdered sugar 1 tsp green food coloring Optional: ﻿﻿¼ cup heavy whipping cream (pour on rolls before baking) ﻿﻿Heart sprinkles/candy 🎄instructions🎄 -Heat the milk in 20-second intervals until it reaches 100–110°F. Stir in the yeast and let it sit for 5–10 minutes to bloom.  -In a large bowl (or the bowl of a stand mixer), add the melted butter, vanilla, eggs, and brown sugar. Mix until smooth, then pour in the activated milk-yeast mixture. -Add the flour, salt, and green food coloring. Mix on low speed for 2 minutes, then increase to medium speed and knead for 8–10 minutes. If mixing by hand, use a wooden spoon to bring the dough together, then knead on a floured surface for 10–12 minutes. -Place the dough in a greased bowl. Cover with a clean towel and let rise in a warm area for 1–1.5 hours, or until doubled in size. -During the last 15–20 minutes of rising, prepare the filling. Mix the melted butter and cookie butter until smooth; set aside. -In a separate bowl, mix together the brown sugar and cinnamon; set aside. -Once the dough has risen, punch it down. Flour your surface and roll the dough into a 12×18-inch rectangle. -Spread the butter–cookie butter mixture evenly over the dough. -Sprinkle the cinnamon sugar on top and gently press it into the dough. -Cut the dough into 12 equal strips and roll each strip into a swirl. -Grease your baking dish with softened butter. -Add the rolls to the dish, cover with a clean towel, and let rise for 30–45 minutes until puffy. -Preheat the oven to 350°F. -Pour the heavy whipping cream over the rolls. -Bake for 25–30 minutes, or until the tops are golden. -While the rolls bake, make the frosting: In a medium bowl, beat together the cream cheese, butter, and cookie butter until smooth. -Add the powdered sugar and green food coloring; beat until fully incorporated, light, and fluffy. -Spread the frosting over the warm rolls. -Add heart sprinkles and enjoy immediately! 💚  #cinnamonroll #cookiebutter #christmasbaking #grinch #creatorsearchinsights

'The Audi TT' is a production front-engine, 2-door, 2+2 sports coupé and roadster, manufactured and marketed by Audi from 1998 to 2023 across three generations. For each of its three generations, the TT has been based on consecutive generations of Volkswagen's "Group A" platforms, starting with its "PQ34" fourth generation. The TT shares powertrain and suspension layouts with its platform mates, including the Audi A3, like a transversely mounted front-engine, powering front-wheel drive or four-wheel drive, and fully independent suspension using MacPherson struts in front. The TT's first two generations were assembled by Audi's Hungarian subsidiary, one of the world's largest engine manufacturing plants, using bodyshells manufactured and painted at Audi's Ingolstadt plant and parts made entirely by the Hungarian factory for the third generation. The last of the 662,762 Audi TTs was manufactured in November 2023. - Motorsport In auto racing, the Istook's Motorsports team has currently entered a Revo Technik-sponsored Audi TT in the Grand-Am KONI Sports Car Challenge Street Tuner (ST) class. Under the racing name of RS Werkes, Istook's Motorsports out of Fort Worth, Texas, built and raced the first TT RS brought into the United States in the Grand Am GS class in 2012, 2013 and 2014. An Audi TT RS was used at the 2009 24 Hours of Le Mans race as the safety car. The Abt Sportsline team entered a TT into the DTM, and Laurent Aïello took the title in 2002. Istook's Motorsports has also raced the TT in SCCA's World Challenge race series. Because of their racing involvement, they received the first U.S. Version of the TT-RS in July 2011. - Audi TT Offroad The Audi TT Offroad Concept was unveiled as an SUV concept version of the Audi TT at the 2014 Auto China. The SUV utilized a hybrid system coupled with the 2.0-litre TFSI Inline-4 engine producing a total of 304 kW (413 PS; 408 hp) and 649 N⋅m (479 lb⋅ft) of torque. The SUV utilises a 6-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The hybrid system consists of a 40 kW (54 PS; 54 hp) electric motor on the front axle and an 85 kW (116 PS; 114 hp) electric motor on the rear axle. In full EV mode, the vehicle uses the rear motor only; Hybrid and Sport modes utilise all three power sources, and all-wheel-drive traction is applied as needed. Performance figures include a 0–62 mph (0–100 km/h) acceleration time of 5.2 seconds and an electronically limited top speed of 155 mph (249 km/h). The distinguishing features of the concept include matrix LED headlights and two new assistance systems: One that scans intersections for potentially dangerous situations, and a second that connects to a municipality's traffic-light system in order to recommend a perfect speed to reach the next light when it is green. The interior is relatively close to the TT's with leather upholstery from Italian fashion brand Poltrona Frau and features a high-tech TFT display in front of the driver populated with the information that would normally be projected onto a central, dash-mounted screen—i.e. navigation, entertainment. Japón 2024 👌 Lo que empezó como una idea y se convirtió en una gran experiencia 🇲🇽🇯🇵 Muchas gracias chef Marco y Yu por hacer esto realidad. Cuando recibimos la invitación para llevar nuestra cocina tradicional a Japón la primer pregunta que nos hicimos fue ¿y cómo vamos a preparar la barbacoa?, porque obviamente íbamos a estar muy lejos de casa y nos preocupábamos por los ingredientes y herramientas que se necesitan para hacer una buena barbacoa.  Así que desde Oaxaca nos llevamos chiles, especias, una parrilla y otros implementos, sin embargo fue una total sorpresa el ver como el chef Marco y todo su equipo hicieron todo lo posible por proporcionarnos el resto de ingredientes.  La carne de borrego fue de un granjero local, las pencas de maguey las enviaron desde otra ciudad ya que son muy difíciles de conseguir, cemento, ladrillos, piedras de río, todo lo que pedimos nos lo proporcionaron, y eso es un gesto que sin duda nos hizo muy felices y que siempre vamos a recordar.  Así que sin más ni más pusimos manos a la obra, en comunidad y con ayuda de todo el equipo empezamos a trabajar, unos a escarbar el horno, otros se dedicaban a preparar el cemento, Charlie se puso a pegar los ladrillos y todo funcionaba al mero estilo japonés, con mucha perfección; nos anocheció y ya casi al terminar se sentía la emoción de que estábamos apunto de lograr algo importante, así que hubo que ponerle un toque mexicano y empezó la fiesta, pusimos canciones de banda, llegó el mezcal, las cervezas y entre muchos brindis por fin quedó listo el horno, fuimos muy felices en ese momento. Lo dejamos secar y al otro día fue el momento para que Carlos le prendiera lumbre, obviamente que primero le echamos su bendición con mezcal y ahora si leña y piedras de río, calentamos el horno por varias horas y al fin estuvo listo para meter la barbacoa. Esta colaboración duró dos días, donde personas de la comunidad, chefs, artistas y muchas otras personas se dieron cita para probar la@rica barbacoa que preparamos para ellos. Cuando destapamos el horno, realizamos nuestro tradicional compadrazgo y así fue como ahora me gané 2 compadres y 2 comadres más a la lista. Ini menjadi obat bagi hati yang resah, penguat bagi jiwa yang sedang gundah, dan penyejuk untuk orang yang hidupnya penuh tekanan. 2. Meringankan Beban Kehidupan Allah berfirman: “Wa wadhana ‘anka wizrak” (Dan Kami telah meringankan darimu bebanmu). Artinya, siapa pun yang membaca surah ini dengan ikhlas, Allah akan menolongnya dalam menghadapi kesulitan hidup, serta meringankan segala urusannya. 3. Mengangkat Derajat & Memberi Kemuliaan Ayat: “Wa rafa’na laka dzikrak” (Dan Kami tinggikan bagimu sebutanmu). Surah ini mengandung rahasia pengangkatan derajat. Orang yang istiqamah membacanya akan dimuliakan Allah, dipermudah langkahnya, serta dihormati manusia. 4. Keyakinan Bahwa Setelah Kesulitan Ada Kemudahan Dua kali Allah menegaskan: “Fa inna ma’al ‘usri yusra, inna ma’al ‘usri yusra” (Sesungguhnya bersama kesulitan ada kemudahan). Banyak orang membacanya ketika hendak memulai pekerjaan penting. 6. Menghilangkan Rasa Putus Asa Surah ini mengajarkan untuk tidak menyerah. Saat seseorang berada dalam titik terendah, Surah Al-Insyirah memberi semangat baru, agar kembali bangkit dan terus berusaha dengan tawakal kepada Allah. 7. you can't end the summer without at least one of these viral pink sugar cookie ice cream cups🍦🌈 Ingredients: 1 package pink frosted sugar cookies 8oz cream cheese (softened) 6 @joyconeco ice cream cups 1 cup white chocolate chips dab of coconut oil red food coloring rainbow sprinkles Instructions:  In a large bowl, mash sugar cookies with room temperature cream cheese and form a dough ball. Separate small sections of cookie dough and form into hollow ice cream cups and flatten at the top. Additionally, form 6 small balls with remaining cookie dough and allow both dough balls and cups to set in fridge until firm. In a small microwave-safe bowl, microwave white chocolate and coconut oil for 30-second increments, stirring each time until melted with a glossy consistency. Add a few drops of food coloring and mix until light pink color is achieved. Once cups and dough balls are firm, spread 1 teaspoon of chocolate on tops of filled cups and place 1 dough ball on top, using chocolate as "glue" to hold it in place. Allow assembled cups to set in fridge until firm, then dip in chocolate and sprinkle with rainbow sprinkles. Creamy baked mac & cheese 🧀🤍 The best side ever! I’ve worked on this recipe for a bit taking inspiration from my mom and Tini’s recipe and I’d say this it’s perfect! Full recipe below  - 1 lb corkscrew pasta  - 4 1/2 tbsp unsalted butter - 3 tbsp flour - 4 cloves garlic, minced - 1 1/2 cups evaporated milk (12 oz) - 2 cups heavy cream - 1/2 cup half and half  - 4 oz cream cheese, softened - 1/2 lb smoked Gouda - 1/2 lb Colby jack - 1 lb mozzarella  - 7 oz sharp cheddar  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon  - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt & pepper to taste  Instructions - Grate cheese blocks and separate in two large bowls and set aside.  - Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the elbow macaroni and cook according to package directions until al dente (usually about 8 minutes). Drain the pasta and set aside. - In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. - Once melted, add half of the seasoning mixture. Mix until combined.Add finely chopped garlic and cook until fragrant. - Add flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, to form a roux. Be careful not to let it brown. - Gradually add the warmed evaporated to the roux, whisking constantly to avoid lumps. Add heavy cream and half & half and continue to cook and whisk until the mixture thickens (about 3-5 minutes). - Stir in the rest of smoked paprika, chicken bouillon, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, salt, and pepper. - Lower the heat and add the shredded cheddar and mozzarella cheeses, stirring until smooth and melted. Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt and pepper if needed. - Add the cooked pasta to the cheese sauce, stirring to coat evenly. - Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). - Transfer the mac and cheese to a baking dish (13x8) add half of the Mac add shredded cheese, and add the rest of the Mac topping with remaining shredded cheese - Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes. Newt is an elder toucan between the age of 16-20. she has developed arthritis in her age which eventually lead her to me after she became disabled and required assisted living. unfortunately, arthritis can be quite crippling to toucans because the majority of their movement is done through hops and jumps. they also use their feet to maintain their beak which can lead to the beak eventually becoming very flaky, itchy and dry. this requires some help from me to restore to it's former glory. the dent is something I was told she's had since before her previous keepers remember. it's likely the result of getting stuck in enclosure bars or perhaps an altercation with another toucan. today, I'm going to be trying to do the best I can to help her feel more normal. flaky beaks in toucans can also be the result of malnutrition or liver issues so please consult a knowledgeable vet before trying to copy anything I do. this is not the first time I've helped a toucan with this sort of thing. if you'd like to help Newt and other birds like her (and help me continue to do these videos)- please consider supporting us on Patreon! thank you for caring about Newt enough to watch. . #restoration #asmr #sanctuary #rescuecats #petvideos

Gumbo 🍛🦐🐓 This is soul food at its finest! I’ve made gumbo a couple of years back and instantly fell in love with it. There is just something so innately comforting and soothing when it comes to stews and this is one of the best ones you can make! Ingredients: Meats: - 5pcs chicken thigh fillet, skin on - 1 kg fresh prawns - 3 pcs Andouille sausage (or any smoked sausage), sliced Veg: - 1 large onion, diced - 1 bellpepper, diced - 4 stalks celery, diced - 8 cloves garlic, minced - 5 dried Bay leaves - 1 sprig Thyme Others: - Vegetable oil  - Flour - Cajun/creole seasoning - 🍺 of choice (preferably amber style) - 4 cups chicken stock  - 4 cups shrimp stock (from shrimp shells) - Salt & pepper to taste Instructions: - Sear your seasoned chicken thighs on high heat until skin turns crispy and golden. Set aside and in the same pan add about 1/2 cup oil and 1/2 cup flour to make a roux. You want to cook this over low heat until it turns into a dark amber color. - Add your onions, peppers, celery and garlic to your roux and saute until onions are translucent. Add in your 🍺 and cook off until alc eveporates. - Add in your prepared shrimp and chicken stock and cook for 30 mins until sauce thickens. - Add in back in your chicken along with your sausages and season with your preferred cajun/creole seasoning along with your thyme and bay leaves. Cook on low for around 1 1/2 hrs. - Add your peeled and deveined shrimp at the end so it doesn’t get tough and cook for another 10mins. - Serve piping hot with rice and enjoy!  ❤️ #gumbo #cajun #creole #soulfood #seafoodgumbo #neworleansfood #louisiana #stew #cookingasmr #asmr

Autopsia de Kobe Bryant revela cómo quedó su cuerpo tras su muerte En el video de la autopsia se supo que que gran parte de su cuerpo sufrió quemaduras así como la fractura expuesta de u espina dorsal y más detalles La leyenda del baloncesto Kobe Bryant murió en enero del 2020; su fallecimiento conmocionó al mundo del deporte debido a que sufrió una muerte trágica junto a su hija; el helicóptero en el que viajaban se desplomó. Las investigaciones revelaron que la densa niebla ocasionó que el piloto no tuviera control sobre la nave, por lo que sería la causa del desplome, todos los tripulantes de la nave perecieron instantáneamente. Kobe murió a los 41 años, junto a su hija Gianna de 13; varios días después de la muerte del deportista legendario, se filtraría el resultado de la supuesta autopsia. Autopsia de Kobe Bryant La supuesta autopsia de Kobe revelaría el grave daño que habría sufrido Bryant al desplomarse la aeronave en los Ángeles. También las quemaduras de segundo y tercer grado que habrían carbonizado buena parte de su torso, así como la falta de uno de los brazos y una fractura expuesta de la espina dorsal que habría salido por la parte del cuello. Once golden, set the chicken aside for later. - In the same pot, sauté your vegetables until fragrant, then add Italian seasoning. add your chicken broth. - Return the chicken to the pot and set it to a gentle simmer for 45 minutes, or until tender. Once done, shred the chicken and add back to the soup. - Add the orzo pasta and let it cook in the broth for 8–10 minutes - Meanwhile, prepare the avgolemono mixture. In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and add lemon juice/zest. To temper, pour in a thin stream a bit of hot soup while whisking constantly. This will prevent the eggs from scrambling. - Once tempered, gently stir the avgolemono mixture back into the pot. - Serve your soup hot, garnished with fresh dill/parsley and a drizzle of olive oil and enjoy! #Soups #asmr #ASMRCooking

🇮🇳 Onion Bhaji / Pakora / Pakoda 🧅 (Crispy onion fritters)  #indianfood #pakora #bhaji #bajji #onion #FoodTok #asmr #cookingasmr *I mislabeled the besan flour/chickpea flour to suji or semolina flour in the video. Please disregard and use chickpea flour for this 😅 INGREDIENTS Onion fritter: - 1 large white & red onion thinly sliced - 2 tbsp coriander/cilantro (chopped) - 1 green chilli chopped - 1 tsp turmeric/garam masala/kashmiri chili powder - 2 tsp salt - 3/4 cup besan (chickpea/gram flour) - 1/4 cup rice flour - water as needed Raita (yogurt sauce): - 1 cup plain unsweetened yogurt (curd) - 1-2 cucumbers grated  - 2 tbsp mint chopped - 2 tbsp coriander chopped - 1/2 lime juice - Garam masala (optional) - Salt to taste INSTRUCTIONS: - Combine ingredients listed for the onion fritters. Add water a little at a time to form a semi thick batter. Fry at 165C until crispy and golden. Set on a paper towel/wire rack. - To make yogurt sauce combine ingredients listed for raita. Make sure to squeeze the cucumbers dry using cheese cloth or a kitchen towel so that the mixture stays thick. - Serve your onion fritters with the yogurt sauce and enjoy ❤️

Frango com creme de batata é muito bom Ingredientes👇: 1kg de peito de frango cortado em cubos  500g de batata descascadas  200g de bacon em cubos 1 cebola picada 2 dentes de alho picados  150g de requeijão cremoso 300g de creme de leite fresco 200g de muçarela 4 colheres de maionese Sal e pimenta do reino  Preparo: Cozinhe as batatas até que fiquem macias, bata no liquidificador com o requeijão, o creme de leite e reserve. Numa panela derreta o bacon e deixe fritar até ficar crocante. Reserve o bacon e na gordura do bacon leve o frango para dourar. Em seguida junte a cebola, o alho e refogue bem. Acrescente o creme de batatas, misture e acrescente o queijo para derreter mexendo bem.
